== Summary ==
Identified: none. The man at the ship's wheel (blue henley and jeans) is the same traveler as [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 2.jpg]], [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 8.jpg]], [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 14.jpg]] (the unlabeled teammate next to the already-named [[Justin Branch]]), [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 20.jpg]], [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 24.jpg]], and [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 26.jpg]]. The face is not [[Marc Nickels]] (2019 Team Wales pirate) and not [[Justin Branch]]. Faces unlabeled.
The [[2022 European Championship]] weekend in Bochum, Germany, from the "Team Wales Photo Log" thread.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-09-08
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
